name: ppt-design-skills
description: Two agent skills for deck work. ppt-design is a methodology plus an execution engine: three theory layers (logic, visual, structure), hard numeric specs, wall-of-text handling, generate and beautify routes that emit editable native .pptx, 14 style presets and a five-dimension self-review. ppt-master is a tool-neutral production workflow in Chinese: requirements, narrative, design system, layout rotation, data-visualisation rules, pptxgenjs and python-pptx implementation guidance, and a mandatory visual QA pass.
